response.original_title: 夢の見つけ方教えたる！
response.overview: An elementary school teacher who lost his passion for his job and became lethargic is assigned to an elementary school in the Kanto region. However, the school was just a "bullying eradication model school" with many problems for students and teachers.  Initially, the man doesn't intend to do anything about it, but over time, due to the flood of his own memories from his school days, he decides to teach his students a life lesson.
response.title: 夢の見つけ方教えたる！

titles.title: You ... ~ That Word That Made Me a Teacher
